B/c Swarnkar, R/o Subhash Chowk, Ratanada, Jodhpur.

----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Nagraj Goswami For Respondent(s) : Mr. S.K. Bhati, P.P.
 Ms. Pooja Soni, for the complainant.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 17/10/2023

The instant criminal misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioners assailing the order dated 15.04.2023 passed by learned Judicial Magistrate, Jodhpur,
District Jodhpur and proceedings pertaining to Regular Criminal Misc. Case No.124/2017 for the offence under Section 498A IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the parties have settled their disputes and have arrived at a compromise.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He therefore prayed that the impugned proceedings may kindly be quashed.
Learned counsel for the complainant concurs the factum of compromise and submits that in view of the compromise, the complainant is not inclined to proceed further in the matter.

In view of compromise arrived at between the parties and applying the ratio in decision of Gian Singh (Supra) and B.S. Joshi (supra), this Court deems it just and proper to invoke inherent powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the present misc. petition is allowed.

All consequential proceedings pending before learned Judicial Magistrate, Jodhpur in Regular Criminal Misc. Case No.124/17 for the offence under Section 498A IPC, are quashed on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.
The order dated 15.04.2023 passed by Judicial Magistrate, Jodhpur, District Jodhpur is modified accordingly.
